apple_source.provenance: Public Apple XNU main fetched 2026-10-16 for corroboration, not claimed to be exact installed iOS kernel source.
apple_source.finding: flock and OFD operations share VNOP_ADVLOCK/lockf overlap checks. Different fileglobs have distinct ownership. Whole-file flock EX conflicts with overlapping OFD read lock and returns EAGAIN for nonblocking acquisition.
apple_source.correction: Earlier source-only assumption that Darwin auto locking is necessarily disabled was incorrect. Apple exposes F_OFD_SETLK and the actual device byte100 message shows QEMU lock code executed. Linux flock/OFD independence cannot establish Darwin behavior.

implementation.scope: Only terminal userdata -drive gains file.locking=off; original probe argv and JIT/SideStore paths unchanged.
implementation.single_writer: Exclusive nonblocking flock remains on userdata.raw itself from validated open until process exit, also after clean stop. Every app disk owner acquires this lock. synchronize never closes/unlocks. No sidecar lock, reset, replacement, unlink or format during validation.
implementation.capability: arguments accepts LinuxTerminalDisk, no diskURL-only overload; validates live owner before assets/session. Worker validates again before qemuInitBegin and handing native endpoints to C.
implementation.failure: Static diskOwnership diagnostic code; fail closed before C; preserve existing data. Manual safe native summary labels exact byte100 failure without copying arbitrary log text; association remains UNKNOWN.
implementation.limits: Advisory ownership protects cooperating app launches/writers. It does not exclude an arbitrary noncooperating external writer or make pathname-based QEMU open atomic against hostile concurrent replacement. App-owned private directory and repeated identity checks preserve existing trust model.
